newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian export bank share offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian export bank share offer oversubscribed.

text.p: Export Development Bank of Egypt said on Saturday its offer of shares worth almost 60 million pounds ($17.6 million) was subscribed 10 times over.
The share issue, to raise the bank's paid-in capital to 250 million pounds, will reduce the state's holding in the bank to about 75 percent from 98.52 percent.
Subscribers have to pay 250 pounds for the 597,280 shares on offer -- 100 pounds towards the bank's capital and the balance of 150 pounds towards its reserves.
The bank said it received more than 85,000 applications for the shares but did not say how it had allocated them.
